Standpoint Modality

  • CURIE: gmeow:StandpointModality
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/StandpointModality
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/standpoint

The belief value a standpoint assigns a proposition — a closed value vocabulary spanning the Standpoint-Logic □/◊ and the CRMinf belief value (true/false/probable/possible), plus the Frankfurt bullshit modality: gmeow:unequivocal, gmeow:probable, gmeow:conceivable, gmeow:refuted, gmeow:bullshit. Absence of a value is read as unequivocal.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:StandpointModality as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
